title.zh: 卷二十二 本紀第二十二: 道宗二
title.raw: 卷二十二 本紀第二十二: 道宗二 Volume 22 Annals 22: Daozong 2

sentences.zh: 道宗二

translations.literal: Daozong, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: Daozong, Part Two

sentences.zh: 八年春正月癸丑，如鴨子河。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on guichou day, went to the Duck River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on guichou day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.

sentences.zh: 二月，駐蹕納葛濼。

translations.literal: Second month, halted at Nage Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the court halted at Nage Marsh.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申朔，楚王蕭革致仕，進封鄭國王。

translations.literal: Third month, on wushen new moon, Prince of Chu Xiao Ge retired and was advanced to Prince of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen new moon of the third month Prince of Chu Xiao Ge retired and was advanced to Prince of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，吾獨婉惕隱屯禿葛等乞歲貢馬、駝，許之。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, Wuduwan tiyin Tutugu and others begged yearly tribute of horses and camels; permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth summer month Wuduwan tiyin Tutugu and others begged yearly tribute of horses and camels; permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子朔，駐蹕拖古烈。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingzi new moon, halted at Tuogulie.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon of the sixth month the court halted at Tuogulie.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以右夷離畢奚馬六為奚六部大王。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Right yilibi Xima Liu was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Right yilibi Xima Liu was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.

sentences.zh: 是月，禦清涼殿放進士王鼎等九十三人。

translations.literal: That month, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Wang Ding and ninety-three others were passed.
translations.idiomatic: That month, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Wang Ding and ninety-three others were passed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，射熊於外室剌。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiazi day, shot a bear at Waisila.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the seventh autumn month a bear was shot at Waisila.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌朔，駐蹕獨盧金。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiaxu new moon, halted at Dulujin.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the tenth winter month the court halted at Dulujin.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，以知北院樞密使事蕭圖古辭為北院樞密使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on gengchen day, Yelü Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day of the twelfth month Yelü Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸西京。

translations.literal: On guimao day visited the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the court visited the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以皇太后行再生禮，曲赦西京囚。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, because the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth ritual, partial amnesty for prisoners at the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, because the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth ritual, a partial amnesty was granted for prisoners at the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月辛亥，幸鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on xinhai day, visited Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on xinhai day of the first spring month the court visited Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 辛未，禁民鬻銅。

translations.literal: On xinwei day forbidden the people to sell copper.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the people were forbidden to sell copper.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，宋主禎殂，以侄曙為子嗣位。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinwei day Song ruler Zhen died; his nephew Shu succeeded as adopted son and took the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day of the third month Song ruler Zhen died; his nephew Shu succeeded as adopted son and took the throne.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙午，以隋王仁先為南院樞密使，徙封許王。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, on bingwu day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day of the fifth summer month Prince of Sui Renxian was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Xu.

sentences.zh: 是月，清暑曷裏狘。

translations.literal: That month, summered at Helibie.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court summered at Helibie.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，如太子山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingchen day, went to Crown Prince Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Crown Prince Mountain.

sentences.zh: 戊午，皇太叔重元與其子楚國王涅魯古及陳國王陳六、同知北院樞密使事蕭胡睹、衛王貼不、林牙涅剌溥古、統軍使蕭叠裏得、駙馬都尉參及弟術者、圖骨、旗鼓拽剌詳穩耶律郭九、文班太保奚叔、內藏提點烏骨、護衛左太保敵不古、按答、副宮使韓家奴、寶神奴等凡四百人，誘脅弩手軍犯行宮。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.

sentences.zh: 時南院樞密使許王仁先、知北樞密院事趙王耶律乙辛、南府宰相蕭唐古、北院宣徽使蕭韓家奴、北院樞密副使蕭惟信、敦睦宮使耶律良等率宿衛士卒數千人禦之。

translations.literal: At the time Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Xu Renxian, Yelü Yixin who administered Northern Privy Council affairs, Southern Court chancellor Xiao Tanggu, Northern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hanjianu, Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin, Dunmu Palace commissioner Yelü Liang, and others led several thousand night-guard troops to resist.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Xu Renxian, Yelü Yixin who administered Northern Privy Council affairs, Southern Court chancellor Xiao Tanggu, Northern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hanjianu, Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin, Dunmu Palace commissioner Yelü Liang, and others led several thousand night-guard troops to resist.

sentences.zh: 涅魯古躍馬突出，將戰，為近侍詳穩渤海阿廝、護衛蘇射殺之。

translations.literal: Nielugu leaped his horse forward and was about to fight when he was shot and killed by attendant detail-stable Bohai Asi and guard Su.
translations.idiomatic: Nielugu leaped his horse forward and was about to fight when he was shot and killed by attendant detail-stable Bohai Asi and guard Su.

sentences.zh: 己未，族逆黨家。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the families of the rebel party were exterminated by clan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the families of the rebel party were exterminated by clan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，重元亡入大漠，自殺。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Chongyuan fled into the great desert and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Chongyuan fled into the great desert and killed himself.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔諭諸道。

translations.literal: On xinyou day edict instructed all routes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict instructed all routes.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以仁先為北院樞密使，進封宋王，加尚父，耶律乙辛南院樞密使，蕭韓家奴殿前都點檢，封荊王。

translations.literal: On renxu day Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner, advanced to Prince of Song and honored as imperial father; Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; Xiao Hanjianu Palace Front commander and enfeoffed Prince of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner, advanced to Prince of Song and honored as imperial father; Yelü Yixin was made Southern Court privy commissioner; Xiao Hanjianu was made Palace Front commander and enfeoffed Prince of Jing.

sentences.zh: 蕭惟信、耶律馮家奴並加太子太傅。

translations.literal: Xiao Weixin and Yelü Fengjianu were both promoted Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Weixin and Yelü Fengjianu were both promoted Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 宿衛官蕭乙辛、回鶻海鄰、裏、耶律撻不也、阿廝、宮分人急裏哥、霞抹、乙辛、只魯並加上將軍。

translations.literal: Night-guard officials Xiao Yixin, Uighur Hailin, Li, Yelü Tabuye, Asi, palace division men Jilige, Xiamo, Yixin, Zhilu were all promoted upper generals.
translations.idiomatic: Night-guard officials Xiao Yixin, Uighur Hailin, Li, Yelü Tabuye, Asi, palace division men Jilige, Xiamo, Yixin, and Zhilu were all promoted upper generals.

sentences.zh: 諸護衛及士卒、庖夫、弩手、傘子等三百餘人，各授官有差。

translations.literal: More than three hundred guards, soldiers, cooks, crossbowmen, umbrella-bearers, and the like each received office by degree.
translations.idiomatic: More than three hundred guards, soldiers, cooks, crossbowmen, umbrella-bearers, and the like each received office by degree.

sentences.zh: 耶律良密告重元變，命籍橫帳夷離堇房，為漢人行宮都部署。

translations.literal: Yelü Liang had secretly reported Chongyuan's plot; ordered the horizontal-account yilijin houses registered; made Han mobile palace deployment director.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Liang had secretly reported Chongyuan's plot; the horizontal-account yilijin houses were ordered registered; he was made Han mobile palace deployment director.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，貼不訴為重元等所脅，詔削爵為民，流鎮州。

translations.literal: On guihai day Tiebu pleaded that he had been coerced by Chongyuan and the others; edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner, exiled to Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Tiebu pleaded that he had been coerced by Chongyuan and the others; an edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner, exiled to Zhen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以黑白羊祭天。

translations.literal: On wuchen day black and white sheep were used to sacrifice to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day black and white sheep were used to sacrifice to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午朔，遣使安撫南京吏民。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on gengwu new moon, dispatched envoys to reassure officials and people at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the eighth month envoys were dispatched to reassure officials and people at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以永興宮使耶律塔不也有定亂動，為同知點檢司事。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Yongxing Palace commissioner Yelü Tabuye, for merit in quelling disorder, was made associate commander of the Inspection Office.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Yongxing Palace commissioner Yelü Tabuye, for merit in quelling disorder, was made associate commander of the Inspection Office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰朔，幸興王寺。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuchen new moon, visited Xingwang Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited Xingwang Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以六院部太保耶律合術知南院大王事。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Six Courts grand guardian Yelü Heshu was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Six Courts grand guardian Yelü Heshu was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs.

sentences.zh: 是月，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: That month halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，以南院宣徽使蕭九哥為北府宰相。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinchou day Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Jiuge was made Northern Court chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day of the eleventh month Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Jiuge was made Northern Court chancellor.

sentences.zh: 己未，追封故富春郡王耶律義先為許王。

translations.literal: On jiwei day posthumously enfeoffed the late Prince of Fuchun Yelü Yixian as Prince of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the late Prince of Fuchun Yelü Yixian was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xu.

sentences.zh: 是歲，封皇子浚為梁王。

translations.literal: That year the imperial son Jun was enfeoffed Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: That year the imperial son Jun was enfeoffed Prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月己亥，北幸。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on jihai day, traveled north.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on jihai day of the first spring month the court traveled north.

sentences.zh: 二月，禁南京民決水種粳稻。

translations.literal: Second month, forbidden Nanjing people to breach dikes to plant glutinous rice.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Nanjing people were forbidden to breach dikes to plant glutinous rice.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，詔決諸路囚。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renshen day, edict ordered prisoners in all routes decided.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered prisoners in all routes decided.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，禁僧尼私詣行在，妄述禍福取財物。

translations.literal: On xinsi day forbidden monks and nuns to visit the imperial halt privately, falsely declaring fortune and misfortune to take property.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day monks and nuns were forbidden to visit the imperial halt privately or falsely declare fortune and misfortune to take property.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，幸懷州，謁太宗、穆宗廟。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, visited Huai Prefecture and paid respects at Taizong's and Muzong's temples.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day of the ninth month the court visited Huai Prefecture and paid respects at Taizong's and Muzong's temples.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰朔，駐蹕中京。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renchen new moon, halted at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the tenth winter month the court halted at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，禁民私刊印文字。

translations.literal: On wuwu day forbidden the people to print texts privately.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the people were forbidden to print texts privately.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，定吏民衣服之制。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiazi day, fixed regulations for officials' and commoners' clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the eleventh month regulations were fixed for officials' and commoners' clothing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，禁六齋日屠殺。

translations.literal: On xinwei day forbidden slaughter on the six fast days.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day slaughter on the six fast days was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔求乾文閣所闕經籍，命儒臣校讎。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, edict sought missing classics from the Qianwen Pavilion and ordered Confucian ministers to collate and emend.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict sought missing classics from the Qianwen Pavilion and ordered Confucian ministers to collate and emend.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以彰國軍節度使韓謝十為惕隱。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Zhangguo Army military commissioner Han Xieshi was made tiyin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Zhangguo Army military commissioner Han Xieshi was made tiyin.

sentences.zh: 詔南京不得私造御用彩緞，私貨鐵，及非時飲酒。

translations.literal: Edict ordered Nanjing not to manufacture imperial-colored silks privately, smuggle iron, or drink wine out of season.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Nanjing not to manufacture imperial-colored silks privately, smuggle iron, or drink wine out of season.

sentences.zh: 命南京三司，每歲春秋以官錢饗將士。

translations.literal: Ordered Nanjing's Three Departments each spring and autumn to feast soldiers with official funds.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing's Three Departments were ordered each spring and autumn to feast soldiers with official funds.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，以北院大王蕭兀古匿為契丹行宮都部署。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on guisi day Northern Court great king Xiao Wuguini was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day of the twelfth month Northern Court great king Xiao Wuguini was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

sentences.zh: 是歲，南京、西京大熟。

translations.literal: That year Nanjing and the Western Capital had great harvests.
translations.idiomatic: That year Nanjing and the Western Capital had great harvests.

sentences.zh: 咸雍元年春正月辛酉朔，文武百僚加上尊號曰聖文神武全功大略廣智聰仁睿孝天佑皇帝。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianyong, spring, first month, on xinyou new moon, civil and military officials presented the honorific title Sagely, Cultured, Spiritually Martial, All-Achieving, Great Strategy, Broad Wisdom, Perceptive, Benevolent, Sagely, Filial, Heavenly Blessing Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianyong, on the xinyou new moon of the first spring month civil and military officials presented the honorific title Sagely, Cultured, Spiritually Martial, All-Achieving, Great Strategy, Broad Wisdom, Perceptive, Benevolent, Sagely, Filial, Heavenly Blessing Emperor.

sentences.zh: 改元，大赦。

translations.literal: The era name was changed and a general amnesty proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 冊梁王浚為皇太子，內外官賜級有差。

translations.literal: Prince of Liang Jun was invested crown prince; inner and outer officials were granted rank by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Liang Jun was invested crown prince; inner and outer officials were granted rank by degree.

sentences.zh: 甲子，如魚兒濼。

translations.literal: On jiazi day went to Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the court went to Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔諸遇正旦、重午、冬至，別表賀東宮。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, edict ordered that on encountering New Year's Day, Double Fifth, and winter solstice, separate memorials congratulating the Eastern Palace were to be presented.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict ordered that on New Year's Day, Double Fifth, and winter solstice, separate memorials congratulating the Eastern Palace were to be presented.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，以知興中府事楊績知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Third month, on dinghai day, Yang Ji, who administered Xingzhong Prefecture, was made to administer Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day of the third month Yang Ji, who administered Xingzhong Prefecture, was made to administer Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，以知樞密院事張嗣復疾，改知興中府事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinmao day, because Zhang Sifu, who administered Privy Council affairs, was ill, he was changed to administer Xingzhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day of the fourth summer month, because Zhang Sifu, who administered Privy Council affairs, was ill, he was changed to administer Xingzhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚子，清暑拖古烈。

translations.literal: On gengzi day summered at Tuogulie.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the court summered at Tuogulie.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，夏國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on xinsi day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day of the fifth month Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，以皇太后射獲熊，賞賚百官有差。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingzi day, because the Empress Dowager shot and captured a bear, officials were rewarded by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the seventh autumn month, because the Empress Dowager shot and captured a bear, officials were rewarded by degree.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，客星犯天廟。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingshen day a guest star violated the Heavenly Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day of the eighth month a guest star violated the Heavenly Temple.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路備盜賊，嚴火禁。

translations.literal: Edict ordered all routes to prepare against bandits and strictly forbid fire.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered all routes to prepare against bandits and strictly forbid fire.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yihai day, halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，左夷離畢慥古為孟父敞穩。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Left yilibi Zaogu was made Mengfu detail-stable.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Left yilibi Zaogu was made Mengfu detail-stable.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，幸醫巫閭山。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dinghai new moon, visited Yiwulü Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited Yiwulü Mountain.

sentences.zh: 己亥，皇太后射獲虎，大宴群臣，令各賦詩。

translations.literal: On jihai day the Empress Dowager shot and captured a tiger; a great feast was held for ministers and each ordered to compose a poem.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Empress Dowager shot and captured a tiger; a great feast was held for ministers and each was ordered to compose a poem.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，有星如鬥，逆行，隱隱有聲。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renxu day there was a star like a dipper, moving retrograde, with a faint sound.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day of the eleventh month there was a star like a dipper, moving retrograde, with a faint sound.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，以遼王仁先為南京留守，徙封晉王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiawu day Prince of Liao Renxian was made regent of Nanjing and transferred to Prince of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day of the twelfth month Prince of Liao Renxian was made regent of Nanjing and transferred to Prince of Jin.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以南京留守蕭惟信為左夷離畢。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Nanjing regent Xiao Weixin was made Left yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Nanjing regent Xiao Weixin was made Left yilibi.

sentences.zh: 壬子，熒惑與月並行，自旦至午。

translations.literal: On renzi day Mars traveled with the moon from dawn to noon.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Mars traveled with the moon from dawn to noon.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁巳，如鴨子河。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on dingsi day, went to the Duck River.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on dingsi day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.

sentences.zh: 宋賀正使王嚴卒，以禮送還。

translations.literal: Song envoy congratulating the New Year Wang Yan died; he was sent back with full rites.
translations.idiomatic: Song envoy congratulating the New Year Wang Yan died; he was sent back with full rites.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸山榆澱。

translations.literal: On guimao day visited Shanyu Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the court visited Shanyu Marsh.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，詔武定軍節度使姚景行，問以治道，拜南院樞密使。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiawu day, edict to Wuding Army military commissioner Yao Jingxing inquiring on the way of governance; he was appointed Southern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day of the second month Wuding Army military commissioner Yao Jingxing was edicted on the way of governance and appointed Southern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，以東北路詳穩耶律韓福奴為北院大王。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinsi day Northeast Route detail-stable Yelü Hanfunu was made Northern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day of the third month Northeast Route detail-stable Yelü Hanfunu was made Northern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 壬午，彗星見於西方。

translations.literal: On renwu day a comet appeared in the west.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day a comet appeared in the west.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，霖雨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, continuous rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month there was continuous rain.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，駐蹕拖古烈。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on yihai day, halted at Tuogulie.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day of the fifth month the court halted at Tuogulie.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以戶部使劉詵為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Household Commissioner Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Household Commissioner Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingxu day Uighur came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the sixth month Uighur came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Zubu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Zubu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑朔，以西北路招討使蕭術者為北府宰相，左夷離畢蕭惟信南院樞密使，同知南院樞密使事耶律白惕隱。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guichou new moon, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Muzhe was made Northern Court chancellor; Left yilibi Xiao Weixin Southern Court privy commissioner; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Bai tiyin.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the seventh autumn month Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Muzhe was made Northern Court chancellor; Left yilibi Xiao Weixin Southern Court privy commissioner; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Bai tiyin.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，南院樞密使姚景行致仕。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Southern Court privy commissioner Yao Jingxing retired.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Southern Court privy commissioner Yao Jingxing retired.

sentences.zh: 庚申，錄囚。

translations.literal: On gengshen day reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，景行復前職。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Jingxing resumed his former post.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Jingxing resumed his former post.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，如藕絲澱。

translations.literal: On dingmao day went to Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the court went to Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 以歲旱，遣使振山後貧民。

translations.literal: Because of drought that year, envoys were dispatched to relieve poor people beyond the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Because of drought that year, envoys were dispatched to relieve poor people beyond the mountains.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renzi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the ninth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以參知政事韓孚為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Associate Administrator of Affairs Han Fu was made associate privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Administrator of Affairs Han Fu was made associate privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月壬午，以知樞密院事楊績為南院樞密使，樞密副使劉詵參知政事。

translations.literal: Winter, twelfth month, on renwu day Yang Ji, who administered Privy Council affairs, was made Southern Court privy commissioner; associate privy commissioner Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day of the twelfth winter month Yang Ji, who administered Privy Council affairs, was made Southern Court privy commissioner; associate privy commissioner Liu Shen was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊子，僧守志加守司徒。

translations.literal: On wuzi day monk Shouzhi was promoted acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day monk Shouzhi was promoted acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以西京留守合術為南院大王。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Western Capital regent Heshu was made Southern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Western Capital regent Heshu was made Southern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以蕭術者為武定軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Xiao Muzhe was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Xiao Muzhe was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.

sentences.zh: 是年，禦永安殿，放進士張臻等百一人。

translations.literal: That year, at Yong'an Hall the jinshi Zhang Zhen and one hundred one others were passed.
translations.idiomatic: That year, at Yong'an Hall the jinshi Zhang Zhen and one hundred one others were passed.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛亥，如鴨子河。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on xinhai day, went to the Duck River.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on xinhai day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.

sentences.zh: 甲子，禦安流殿釣魚。

translations.literal: On jiazi day fished at Anliu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the court fished at Anliu Hall.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，宋主曙殂，子頊嗣位，遣使告哀；

translations.literal: Third month, on guihai day Song ruler Shu died; his son Xiang succeeded; envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning;
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the third month Song ruler Shu died; his son Xiang succeeded; envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning;

sentences.zh: 即遣右護衛太保蕭撻不也、翰林學士陳覺第吊祭。

translations.literal: immediately dispatched Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Xiao Tabuye and Hanlin academician Chen Juedi to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Xiao Tabuye and Hanlin academician Chen Juedi were immediately dispatched to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁亥，扈駕軍營火，賜錢、粟及馬有差。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on dinghai day, escort army camps caught fire; money, grain, and horses were bestowed by degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dinghai day, escort army camps caught fire; money, grain, and horses were bestowed by degree.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，駐蹕春州北澱。

translations.literal: On xinmao day halted at Chun Prefecture North Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the court halted at Chun Prefecture North Marsh.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以蕭兀古匿為北府宰相。

translations.literal: On yisi day Xiao Wuguini was made Northern Court chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Xiao Wuguini was made Northern Court chancellor.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬辰，駐蹕納葛濼。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, on renchen day, halted at Nage Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the fifth summer month the court halted at Nage Marsh.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賜隨駕官諸工人馬。

translations.literal: On renyin day horses were bestowed on escort officials and various craftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day horses were bestowed on escort officials and various craftsmen.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，有司奏新城縣民楊從謀反，偽署官吏。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wushen day the relevant offices memorialized that Xincheng County commoner Yang Cong plotted rebellion and falsely appointed officials.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day of the sixth month the relevant offices memorialized that Xincheng County commoner Yang Cong plotted rebellion and falsely appointed officials.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「小人無知，此兒戲爾。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Petty men are ignorant; this is child's play.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Petty men are ignorant; this is child's play.

sentences.zh: 」獨流其首惡，餘釋之。

translations.literal: Only the ringleaders were exiled; the rest were released.
translations.idiomatic: Only the ringleaders were exiled; the rest were released.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，宋遣使饋其先帝遺物。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Song dispatched envoys presenting the late emperor's bequeathed goods.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Song sent envoys presenting the late emperor's bequeathed goods.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，宋以即位，遣陳襄來報，即遣知黃龍府事蕭圖古辭、中書舍人馬鉉往賀。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; immediately dispatched Huanglong Prefecture administrator Yelü Tuguci and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; Yelü Tuguci, administrator of Huanglong Prefecture, and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan were immediately dispatched to congratulate.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，南府宰相韓王蕭唐古致仕。

translations.literal: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Prince of Han Xiao Tanggu retired.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Prince of Han Xiao Tanggu retired.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以廣德軍節度使耶律蕊奴為南府宰相，度支使趙徽參知政事。

translations.literal: On renshen day Guangde Army military commissioner Yelü Ruinu was made Southern Court chancellor; Revenue Commissioner Zhao Hui Associate Administrator of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Guangde Army military commissioner Yelü Ruinu was made Southern Court chancellor; Revenue Commissioner Zhao Hui was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，熒惑晝見，凡三十五日。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinchou day Mars was seen in daytime for thirty-five days in all.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day of the seventh autumn month Mars was seen in daytime for thirty-five days in all.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌，詔給諸路囚糧。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on wuxu day, edict ordered grain given to prisoners in all routes.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day of the ninth month an edict ordered grain given to prisoners in all routes.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，幸南京。

translations.literal: On guimao day visited Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the court visited Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬辰，夏國遣使進回鶻僧、金佛、《梵覺經》。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, on renchen day Xia State dispatched envoys presenting Uighur monks, a gold Buddha, and the 《Fanjue Sutra》.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the eleventh winter month Xia State sent envoys presenting Uighur monks, a gold Buddha, and the 《Fanjue Sutra》.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，以參知政事劉詵為樞密副使，東北路詳穩高八南院大王，樞密直學士張孝傑參知政事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingwei day Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner; Northeast Route detail-stable Gao Ba Southern Court great king; Privy Council academician Zhang Xiaojie Associate Administrator of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day of the twelfth month Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner; Northeast Route detail-stable Gao Ba Southern Court great king; Privy Council academician Zhang Xiaojie Associate Administrator of Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以張孝傑同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Zhang Xiaojie was made associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Zhang Xiaojie was made associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，行再生禮，赦死罪以下。

translations.literal: On dingsi day performed the rebirth ritual; amnesty for offenses from capital crime downward.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the rebirth ritual was performed; amnesty was granted for offenses from capital crime downward.

sentences.zh: 是月，夏國王李諒祚薨。

translations.literal: That month Xia State king Li Liangzuo died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xia State king Li Liangzuo died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，南京旱、蝗。

translations.literal: That year Nanjing had drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That year Nanjing had drought and locusts.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on jiaxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙子，如鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: On bingzi day went to Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，改易州兵馬使為安撫使。

translations.literal: On xinsi day changed Yi Prefecture military commissioner to pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Yi Prefecture military commissioner was changed to pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，獵炭山。

translations.literal: On dinghai day hunted at Tanshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the court hunted at Tanshan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣使振西京饑民。

translations.literal: On xinmao day dispatched envoys to relieve hungry people in the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day envoys were dispatched to relieve hungry people in the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰朔，詔元帥府募軍。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiachen new moon, edict ordered the marshal's office to recruit troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen new moon of the second month an edict ordered the marshal's office to recruit troops.

sentences.zh: 壬子，夏國王李諒祚子秉常遣使告哀。

translations.literal: On renzi day Xia State king Li Liangzuo's son Bingchang dispatched envoys to announce the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Xia State king Li Liangzuo's son Bingchang sent envoys to announce the mourning.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，頒行《御製華嚴經贊》。

translations.literal: On guichou day promulgated the 《Imperially Composed Avatamsaka Sutra Eulogy》.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the 《Imperially Composed Avatamsaka Sutra Eulogy》 was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，北行。

translations.literal: On dingmao day traveled north.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the court traveled north.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，遣使夏國吊祭。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingzi day dispatched envoys to Xia State to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the third month envoys were dispatched to Xia State to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 甲申，振應州饑民。

translations.literal: On jiashen day relieved hungry people in Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day hungry people in Ying Prefecture were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔南京除軍行地，餘皆得種稻。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, edict ordered Nanjing that except military march lands, the rest might plant rice.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day an edict ordered Nanjing that except military march lands, the rest might plant rice.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，振朔州饑民。

translations.literal: On gengyin day relieved hungry people in Shuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day hungry people in Shuo Prefecture were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙未，夏國李秉常遣使獻其父諒祚遺物。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Xia State Li Bingchang dispatched envoys presenting his father Liangzuo's bequeathed goods.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Xia State Li Bingchang sent envoys presenting his father Liangzuo's bequeathed goods.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，阿薩蘭回鶻遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuwu day Asalan Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the fourth summer month Asalan Uighur sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，駐蹕拖古烈。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day, halted at Tuogulie.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the fifth month the court halted at Tuogulie.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，西北路雨谷，方三十里。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renzi day the Northwest Route rained grain over an area thirty li square.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day of the sixth month the Northwest Route rained grain over an area thirty li square.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以北院林牙耶律趙三為北院大王，右夷離畢蕭素颯中京留守。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Northern Court linya Yelü Zhaosan was made Northern Court great king; Right yilibi Xiao Susu Central Capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Northern Court linya Yelü Zhaosan was made Northern Court great king; Right yilibi Xiao Susu Central Capital regent.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，置烏古敵烈部都統軍司。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renshen day established the Wugu Dilie inspector-general's office.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the seventh autumn month the Wugu Dilie inspector-general's office was established.

sentences.zh: 丙子，獵黑嶺。

translations.literal: On bingzi day hunted at Heiling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the court hunted at Heiling.

sentences.zh: 是月，南京霖雨，地震。

translations.literal: That month Nanjing had continuous rain and an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month Nanjing had continuous rain and an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jihai day, halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，曲赦南京徒罪以下囚。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinhai day, partial amnesty for convict-labor offenses and below at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the tenth winter month a partial amnesty was granted for convict-labor offenses and below at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 永清、武清、安次、固安、新城、歸義、容城諸縣水，復一歲租。

translations.literal: Yongqing, Wuqing, Anci, Gu'an, Xincheng, Guiyi, and Rongcheng counties had flood; one year's rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Yongqing, Wuqing, Anci, Gu'an, Xincheng, Guiyi, and Rongcheng counties had flood; one year's rent was remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，冊李秉常為夏國王。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Li Bingchang was invested king of Xia State.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Li Bingchang was invested king of Xia State.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，夏國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on xinhai day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the twelfth month Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月，阻卜叛，以晉王仁先為西北路招討使，領禁軍討之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, Zubu rebelled; Prince of Jin Renxian was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner to lead forbidden troops against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the first spring month Zubu rebelled; Prince of Jin Renxian was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner to lead forbidden troops against them.

sentences.zh: 夏六月己亥，駐蹕拖古烈。

translations.literal: Summer, sixth month, on jihai day, halted at Tuogulie.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day of the sixth summer month the court halted at Tuogulie.

sentences.zh: 丙午，吐蕃遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以南院樞密使蕭惟信知北院樞密使事。

translations.literal: On renxu day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Weixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Weixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yichou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou new moon of the seventh autumn month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，夏國遣使來謝封冊。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Xia State dispatched envoys to thank the investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Xia State sent envoys to thank the investiture.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔禁皇族恃勢侵漁細民。

translations.literal: On guimao day, edict forbidden the imperial clan to rely on power to encroach on common people.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict forbade the imperial clan to rely on power to encroach on common people.

sentences.zh: 八月，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，仁先遣人奏阻卜捷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on wuchen day Renxian dispatched men to memorialize victory over Zubu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day of the ninth month Renxian dispatched men to memorialize victory over Zubu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jihai day, halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，詔四方館副使止以契丹人充。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on dingmao day, edict ordered Four Directions Bureau deputy commissioners to be filled only by Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the eleventh month an edict ordered Four Directions Bureau deputy commissioners to be filled only by Khitan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，五國剖阿裏部叛，命蕭素颯討之。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the Five States Poali tribe rebelled; Xiao Susu was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Five States Poali tribe rebelled; Xiao Susu was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊申，夏國王李秉常遣使乞賜印綬。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on wushen day Xia State king Li Bingchang dispatched envoys begging seals and credentials.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wushen day, Xia State king Li Bingchang sent envoys begging seals and credentials.

sentences.zh: 己未，僧誌福加守司徒。

translations.literal: On jiwei day monk Zhifu was promoted acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day monk Zhifu was promoted acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，行皇太子再生禮，減諸路徒以下罪一等。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiazi day, because the crown prince performed the rebirth ritual, convict-labor offenses in all routes were reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the twelfth month, because the crown prince performed the rebirth ritual, convict-labor offenses in all routes were reduced one degree.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔百官廷議國政。

translations.literal: On yichou day, edict ordered the hundred officials to debate state affairs at court.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day an edict ordered the hundred officials to debate state affairs at court.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，五國來降。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the Five States came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Five States came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 仍獻方物。

translations.literal: They also presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: They also presented local products.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月戊子，如鴨子河。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on wuzi day, went to the Duck River.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on wuzi day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，女直進馬。

translations.literal: Second month, on yichou day Jurchen presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day of the second month Jurchen presented horses.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以南院樞密使姚景行知興中府事。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Southern Court privy commissioner Yao Jingxing was made administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Southern Court privy commissioner Yao Jingxing was made administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，以討五國功，加知黃龍府事蒲延、懷化軍節度使高元紀、易州觀察使高正並千牛衛上將軍，五國節度使蕭陶蘇斡、寧江州防禦使大榮並靜江軍節度使。

translations.literal: Third month, on jiyou day, for merit against the Five States, Huanglong Prefecture administrator Puyan, Huaihua Army military commissioner Gao Yuanji, and Yi Prefecture observation commissioner Gao Zheng were all promoted Thousand-Ox Guard upper generals; Five States military commissioner Xiao Taosuwan and Ningjiang Prefecture defense commissioner Darong were both made Jingjiang Army military commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day of the third month, for merit against the Five States, Huanglong Prefecture administrator Puyan, Huaihua Army military commissioner Gao Yuanji, and Yi Prefecture observation commissioner Gao Zheng were all promoted Thousand-Ox Guard upper generals; Five States military commissioner Xiao Taosuwan and Ningjiang Prefecture defense commissioner Darong were both made Jingjiang Army military commissioners.

sentences.zh: 幸黑水。

translations.literal: Visited Heishui.
translations.idiomatic: The court visited Heishui.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，如納葛濼。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guiyou day, went to Nage Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the fourth summer month the court went to Nage Marsh.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，禁布帛短狹不中尺度者。

translations.literal: On yihai day forbidden cloth and silk that was short and narrow and did not meet standard measure.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day cloth and silk that was short and narrow and did not meet standard measure was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，吐蕃來貢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jimao day Tibet came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day of the sixth month Tibet came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸未，南院大王高八致仕。

translations.literal: On guimao day Southern Court great king Gao Ba retired.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Southern Court great king Gao Ba retired.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申朔，以東北路詳穩合裏只為南院大王，西南面招討使拾得奴為奚六部大王。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiashen new moon, Northeast Route detail-stable Helizhi was made Southern Court great king; Southwest Route pacification commissioner Shidenunu was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the seventh autumn month Northeast Route detail-stable Helizhi was made Southern Court great king; Southwest Route pacification commissioner Shidenunu was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遣使按問五京囚。

translations.literal: On jichou day dispatched envoys to investigate prisoners in the Five Capitals.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day envoys were dispatched to investigate prisoners in the Five Capitals.

sentences.zh: 庚子，如藕絲澱。

translations.literal: On gengzi day went to Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the court went to Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，置佛骨於招仙浮圖，罷獵，禁屠殺。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on xinsi day Buddha relics were placed in the Zhaoxian pagoda; hunting was stopped and slaughter forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day of the eighth month Buddha relics were placed in the Zhaoxian pagoda; hunting was stopped and slaughter forbidden.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，如醫巫閭山。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jimao day, went to Yiwulü Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day of the tenth winter month the court went to Yiwulü Mountain.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以南府宰相耶律蕊奴為南京統軍使。

translations.literal: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Ruinu was made Nanjing supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Ruinu was made Nanjing supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，謁乾陵。

translations.literal: On wuchen day paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔百官廷議軍國事。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, edict ordered the hundred officials to debate military and state affairs at court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict ordered the hundred officials to debate military and state affairs at court.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，免南京流民租。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on wuzi day remitted rent for Nanjing refugees.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the eleventh month rent for Nanjing refugees was remitted.

sentences.zh: 己丑，振饒州饑民。

translations.literal: On jichou day relieved hungry people in Rao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day hungry people in Rao Prefecture were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙午，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，以契丹行宮都部署耶律胡睹知北院樞密使事，知北院樞密使事蕭惟信為南府宰相，兼契丹行宮都部署。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on renzi day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Hudu was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Yelü Hudu who administered Northern Court privy affairs Xiao Weixin was made Southern Court chancellor and also Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day of the twelfth month Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Hudu was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Xiao Weixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Southern Court chancellor and also Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，漢人行宮都部署李仲禧、北院宣徽使劉霂、樞密副使王觀、都承旨楊興工各賜國姓。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Han mobile palace deployment director Li Zhongxi, Northern Court palace commissioner Liu Li, associate privy commissioner Wang Guan, and chief usher Yang Xinggong were each granted the imperial clan surname.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Han mobile palace deployment director Li Zhongxi, Northern Court palace commissioner Liu Li, associate privy commissioner Wang Guan, and chief usher Yang Xinggong were each granted the imperial clan surname.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Uighur came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Uighur came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，春州鬥粟六錢。

translations.literal: That year, grain at Chun Prefecture was six cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: That year grain at Chun Prefecture was six cash per dou.
